description: Read one change (a specs/changes/<slug>/ folder of a connected repository) as SystemDox last synced it from GitHub: the state of each part of its brief (decision, contract, behaviour, plan) and of its release, each with its pull request; the decision's ADR and status; the contract files; every feature file that names the change, with its scenarios as id · state · title; the plan (plan.md, the draft, the board); the release pull requests; and the Change object as JSON. The last line says "The brief is passed" or "The brief is not passed: <part> is <state>". Call it before building a story, and stop if the brief is not passed or the story's scenarios are not proposed. Read-only.

repo.description: The repository that holds the change, as owner/name

name: get_change
title: Get Change
